newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 3.2 billion yuan from last Friday's 4.6 billion yuan, with the 60-day contract being the most active.
Traders said that turnover fell sharply due to the absense of some short-term financial centres which were the major buyers last Friday, because they had now have sufficient funds.
"If the domestic A share markets continue to trade actively and maintain the upward trend this week, some non-bank financial institutions will return to the market later this week," one trader said.
The big state-owned banks largely stayed on the sidelines with the national financial meeting which began today in Beijing expected to have a significant effect on the market, traders said.
